title: Untitled (Collaboration with Mate)
altText: Massive vertical building facade graffiti mural by Mr Blob and Mate for Sketchmate, featuring a realistic female portrait blending with pink clouds and a surreal Cheshire cat interwoven into giant 3D lettering.
description: Painted with Mate for the SketchMate festival, this mural covers an entire multi-story facade in Chieri with monumental 3D lettering. The upper letterforms host a surreal crowned Cheshire-cat character rendered in warm amber tones, while the lower ones open onto a realistic female portrait gazing upward through banks of pink and purple clouds — a full-scale merger of classic graffiti lettering and figurative muralism.
